description: Pause a campaign: stop enrolling new leads and stop advancing the ones already in it. Reversible — a human reactivates it and enrolled leads resume from where they were. This is also the prerequisite for editing a running sequence. Deliberately available to you even though activation is not: you may always stop mail, and never start it.

workspace.description: Tenant to target (cli_…). Omit to use the active/bound workspace. list_workspaces shows the options.
